name: Ten Auto Repair And Tires
hook: Your customers on Seminole Blvd come in for a patched tire and leave with an engine they trust — they could be booking that visit from their phone before they even drive past the sign. Take a look:
fakt: you've been repairing cars and fitting new and used tires at 5601 Seminole Blvd since 2000, you do everything from maintenance to engine replacement, you run 24-hour towing and you're open six days a week
na_stronie: your name and phone, your own photos (the storefront and bays, the tire racks, the Mustang out front, your tech at the lift), your services in your words — total auto repair, new & used tires, tire repair, mount & balance, brakes, radiators, electrical, fuel & water pumps — online booking Monday to Saturday 8–6 and a contact form straight to your inbox
dlaczego: A tire customer decides in a minute; a page that shows the racks and lets them book from the phone brings the walk-in in before they pick someone else. And every request lands in your email, not on a voicemail while you're under a car.
